subject: MAP review: approval path and credit/discount request
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice@cloudpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call MAP draft + ask for exec/pricing review

Hi Alice — great to meet today. Thanks for the clear context on CloudPay's consolidation goals and your expected Q2 integrations. Per our call, attached is an initial Mutual Action Plan (CPAY_MAP_v1.pdf) and a simple usage projection (usage-projection-CPAY.xlsx).

Quick recap of the commitments and asks from today's discovery:
- Target scope: Redwood hosted inference for transaction routing and reporting pipelines (low-latency gen + embeddings).
- Initial pilot: 3 services, ~200k tokens/day projected ramp to 1M tokens/day by month 6.
- Success metrics: avg latency P95 < 150ms, monthly cost per 1M tokens < $X (we'll refine).

MAP highlights (draft):
1) Pilot kickoff (CloudPay + Redwood): Mar 1 — define test dataset and access
2) Pilot validation: Mar 22 — performance & quality sign-off
3) Production rollout (staged): Apr 12 — full traffic cutover
4) Target close / contract sign: by Mar 15 (to align with CloudPay Q2 budgeting)

Responsibility matrix is in the attached PDF. Two open items that need exec-level signoff from our side before we finalize the commercial terms:
A) Discount / commit level: We proposed two pricing options in the MAP (Option A: 12-month commit at $50k/mo with 12% discount; Option B: 6-month pilot + pay-as-you-go with no discount).
B) One-time platform credit to accelerate proof-of-value (we proposed $20k credit tied to a 12-month commit).

Marissa — can you flag this for pricing/exec review? If we can get signoff on the credit + commit level by EOD Fri (2/27), I can lock the proposed MAP milestones with CloudPay and target Mar 15 close.

Alice / Tom — please review the attached and call out any missing dependencies (legal, security, IAM). We noted your request for SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire — Ben will follow up with the artifacts.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Grace — thanks for the fast turnaround and the MAP. Tom and I skimmed the attachments this morning. A couple quick items from our side:
- Timeline: Mar 15 close works for our procurement window if we get a clean sign-off from our finance lead by Mar 10.
- Security: SOC2 report and the short questionnaire are must-haves before pilot starts. Please share by EOD Thu (Ben mentioned he could).
- SLA / Dedicated capacity: We may need a dedicated pool for the initial 1M tokens/day to guarantee latency; can you indicate whether that changes pricing materially?

On credits/discounts — we're open to the 12-month commit if Redwood can include a modest onboarding credit and a performance SLA baked into the MAP. Can your team confirm a proposed SLA (uptime and latency) in the next version?

Thanks —
Alice Monroe
VP, Product Operations | CloudPay
alice@cloudpay.com | +1 617-555-0987

Rishi / team — looping you in for pricing + credits guidance. Context: CloudPay is a strategic target (payments vertical) and they requested an executive-level credit and a clear SLA. Grace attached a MAP with two options (see her message). Proposed ask: approve a one-time $20k platform credit and a 12% discount on committed spend for a 12-month contract at $50k/mo. Alternative is to approve a pilot package (6 weeks) with a $7k onboarding credit and no long-term discount.

Commercial impact and rationale:
- If we land the 12-mo commit @ $50k/mo (net), that's $600k ARR — good reference in payments.
- The $20k credit accelerates PoV and reduces friction for CloudPay procurement.

Questions for you:
1) Do we have authority to offer $20k one-time credit at the AE/SM level, or does this require GM/RevOps approval?
2) Are there guardrails (contract term, minimum net-new revenue) you want to attach to credits?

I copied Ben for the SLA artifacts request and to confirm whether dedicated capacity changes pricing materially for the first 6 months.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Marissa / Grace — thanks for the summary. I reviewed the MAP and the commercial ask. I approve the following conditional package: 

- Discount: 12% off list pricing for a 12-month committed contract at $50k/month (net of credit).
- One-time onboarding/platform credit: $20,000 applied at contract signature.
- Condition: Customer must sign a 12-month contract with a minimum net-new ARR of $500k (annualized) OR the credit will be clawed back over the first 3 billing cycles.
- SLA: We will commit to an internal P95 latency target in the MAP and will offer a 99.9% availability SLA if CloudPay opts for a Dedicated pool (this may increase unit costs; Ben to provide delta).

Operational asks: route the commercial terms to Legal (for the credit/carry-forward language) and Finance (to pre-approve the credit against the OKR credit budget). I am comfortable with the $20k credit as long as Legal & Finance sign off on the conditional terms above.

Marissa — please capture this in the next MAP revision and loop Legal/Finance. Grace — please confirm with CloudPay that the conditions are acceptable; if they agree we should target doc signature by Mar 12 to hit their procurement window.

Rishi
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference

- Condition: Credit is contingent on a signed 12-month commitment; credit clawback applies if the contract terminates in the first 3 months.
- SLA: 99.9% availability offered if CloudPay elects Dedicated pool; Ben will send a delta cost estimate by EOD Fri.

3) Redwood Legal/Finance: Marissa will put the credit/term language into the commercial redline and route for approval.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to closing this.
